reference: evaluation/semantic-reviewer-cost-qualification-v1/reference-corpus.jsonl authoritative fields (frozen, not human ground truth)

critical_condition_scoring.primary_metric: exact match of evidence_state vs reference critical_evidence_state
critical_condition_scoring.safe_direction: reference CLEAR_TRIGGER_SUPPORT predicted CLEAR_NON_TRIGGER_SUPPORT = under-trigger (missed critical condition)
critical_condition_scoring.dangerous_direction: reference CLEAR_NON_TRIGGER_SUPPORT predicted CLEAR_TRIGGER_SUPPORT = false trigger (false alarm)
critical_condition_scoring.catastrophic: reference CLEAR_NON_TRIGGER_SUPPORT predicted CLEAR_TRIGGER_SUPPORT with high certainty (top probability >= 0.8) - counted separately

forbidden_claim_scoring.pair_semantics: score (match, commitment) as one pair per row
forbidden_claim_scoring.commitment_rule: commitment compared exactly only when reference match == MATCH; for reference NO_MATCH rows commitment is not applicable and ignored when Jev match == NO_MATCH; if Jev match != NO_MATCH on a reference NO_MATCH row the pair is wrong regardless of commitment; for reference UNRESOLVED rows pair correct iff Jev match == UNRESOLVED
forbidden_claim_scoring.enum_note: Jev schema uses exactly the frozen gold enums {MATCH,NO_MATCH,UNRESOLVED} x {ASSERTED,NEGATED,UNRESOLVED}; no mapping table exists and none may be added after outputs

no_tuning_rule: questions, criteria, and thresholds frozen through Phase 7 analysis; any Phase 8 revision limited to 1-2 questions with documented failure pattern

routing_policy_preregistration.note: policy simulation operates on Jev outputs only; thresholds recorded per variant before scoring coverage, variants fixed before Phase 10 table generation
routing_policy_preregistration.noul_uncertainty_band: 0.35-0.65 treated as uncertain zone per TypeSafe docs; no threshold tuned to labels
routing_policy_preregistration.choice_confidence_use: recorded raw; used only as diagnostic in Phase 7, not as routing gate until Phase 9-10 variants are enumerated
